action_items: (Informational) Stage status drift: project.stage_status.DataModel can be 'available' while Discovery stage_context isn't frozen, so Sidebar shows 'Ready' but every endpoint 400s. Consider deriving stage_status server-side from actual stage_context freeze flags in the pipeline endpoint to keep UI/API in lockstep.
(Pre-existing) Nested-button hydration warning in Sidebar.jsx (HelpIcon tooltip inside parent nav <button>) still present — flagged in iteration 5.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/datamodel.py:710-750 — freeze_artifact uses `doc.get('generated_by','')` from the LAST-frozen artifact for `sources.model_used`. If oltp_ddl was frozen first then olap_ddl second, this will record only the olap model. Consider capturing both: {oltp_model: oltp.generated_by, olap_model: olap.generated_by}.

routes/datamodel.py:779-810 reset_stage2 — DOES NOT use the projects collection check, so any project_id (including non-existent) returns 200. That's intentional per the review spec ('does NOT 404 on a project with no artifacts') but could mask typos. Acceptable trade-off.

routes/datamodel.py:819-883 factory_reset — properly 404s on missing project, deletes 12 collections + audit_log + qdrant vectors, then resets stage_status. Looks good. Audit insert at the very end records the deletion summary including potentially the just-deleted audit_log count.
routes/datamodel.py:46-51 _get_prompt fallback to global prompts is correct; no missing-key crash.
routes/datamodel.py:54-56 _safe_format coerces None→empty string, preventing KeyError but leaving silent prompt holes — fine for now.

routes/datamodel.py:587-595 chat endpoint — creates conversation each call when conversation_id is missing. Frontend should persist & resend conversation_id; verify FE behaviour in DataModel.jsx chat section.

datamodel.py:649-651 list_artifacts — sort('updated_at', -1) but DataModelArtifact may not set updated_at on insert (only on update). For brand-new artifacts the sort key is missing → MongoDB sorts those last. Minor; not user-visible until generation happens.
Stage_status drift (see action_items): pipeline.py.require_stage_context checks stage_context doc, while frontend Sidebar reads project.stage_status — these can diverge.
